validity_findings.finding: Fingerprint vector includes Connection: close and Content-Type/Length after filtering Date/Server. Connection is constant across all 40 requests (close) so adds no variance. Content-Length is 41 vs 36 vs 34 and is perfectly correlated with body_hash (body length determines it), making header contribution redundant with body signal. This explains exact equality full_vector_discrimination 0.833333 == B-BODY-ONLY 0.833333. No spurious variance, but header 'adds no information' finding is partly because standard header Content-Length redundantly encodes body size.
